description.en: Components, state, identity, and predictable interactions.
description.zh: 组件、状态、身份与可靠交互。

prerequisite.en: JavaScript functions, arrays, and modules.
prerequisite.zh: 具备 JavaScript 函数、数组和模块基础。

project.en: Build reusable, predictable components.
project.zh: 构建可复用、可预测的组件。

goal.en: Render different interfaces from the same component by changing its inputs.
goal.zh: 让同一个组件，根据输入渲染不同的界面。

check.en: Distinguish a component definition from a particular use of that component
check.zh: 区分组件定义和某次组件调用

goal.en: Find out why three consecutive updates can increase a value only once.
goal.zh: 弄懂为什么连续三次更新，有时只增加一次。

check.en: Explain render snapshots and event-handler closures
check.zh: 解释渲染快照和事件闭包

goal.en: Separate passing handlers from invoking them and control propagation.
goal.zh: 区分传递与调用事件处理器，并控制事件传播。

check.en: Why can onClick={save()} trigger work during render?
check.zh: 为什么 onClick={save()} 会在渲染时执行操作？

goal.en: Keep input values and validation consistent with state.
goal.zh: 让输入值、校验与状态保持一致。

check.en: Why does an input become uneditable when value has no updating handler?
check.zh: 为什么只有 value 而没有更新处理器时输入框无法编辑？

goal.en: Lift shared state to the nearest common owner.
goal.zh: 将共享状态提升到最近的共同所有者。

check.en: Where should selection live when two sibling panels must agree?
check.zh: 两个兄弟面板必须同步选择时，状态应该放在哪里？

goal.en: Define observable acceptance cases for an editable customer-facing interface using React.
goal.zh: 为基于 React 的可编辑的用户界面定义可观测验收用例。

check.en: Which empty, invalid, and duplicate-input cases belong in the acceptance contract?
check.zh: 验收约束应包含哪些空值、非法输入与重复输入场景？

project.en: Keep updates and list identity reliable.
project.zh: 确保状态更新和列表身份可靠。

goal.en: Update a todo correctly while leaving every other item unchanged.
goal.zh: 让待办事项正确更新，同时保持其他项目不变。

check.en: Describe the consequences of mutating an existing object
check.zh: 指出直接修改旧对象的后果

title.zh: 稳定 Key 与组件身份

goal.en: Why can text entered in a list move to the wrong person after sorting?
goal.zh: 列表排序后，输入框里写的内容为什么跑到了别人身上？

check.en: Explain how keys match sibling identities
check.zh: 解释 key 用于匹配兄弟节点身份

goal.en: Synchronize external systems and undo subscriptions.
goal.zh: 同步外部系统，并正确撤销订阅。

check.en: Why must a subscription effect return cleanup when its input changes?
check.zh: 订阅依赖变化时，为什么需要清理旧订阅？

goal.en: Prevent old requests and captured values from overwriting current state.
goal.zh: 防止旧请求与捕获的旧值覆盖当前状态。

check.en: How can a slower search for A overwrite a newer search for B?
check.zh: 较慢的 A 搜索如何覆盖后发的 B 搜索？

title.zh: 引用、上下文与自定义 Hook

goal.en: Separate mutable handles, shared values, and reusable stateful logic.
goal.zh: 区分可变句柄、共享值与可复用状态逻辑。

check.en: Why does writing ref.current not update visible text automatically?
check.zh: 为什么修改 ref.current 不会自动更新可见文字？

goal.en: Protect an editable customer-facing interface with one valid case, one broken implementation, and an independent changed-input case.
goal.zh: 为可编辑的用户界面提供正确用例、错误实现与独立变更输入用例。

check.en: What test would fail for a plausible broken implementation but pass for the intended behavior?
check.zh: 什么测试能让合理但错误的实现失败，并让预期行为通过？

project.en: Model derived data and complex transitions.
project.zh: 处理派生数据与复杂状态转换。

goal.en: Avoid duplicate state so search results stay consistent with their inputs.
goal.zh: 减少重复 state，让搜索结果始终和输入保持一致。

check.en: Explain why useState does not reinitialize when props change
check.zh: 指出 useState 初始化不会跟随 props 重新初始化

goal.en: Extract testable state rules from event handlers.
goal.zh: 把可测试的状态规则从事件处理函数里抽出来。

check.en: Explain the relationship between state, actions, and dispatch
check.zh: 解释 state、action 与 dispatch 的关系

goal.en: Measure expensive work before adding memoization.
goal.zh: 先测量高成本操作，再选择记忆化。

check.en: Why can recreating an object prop defeat a memoized child?
check.zh: 为什么每次重建对象属性可能使子组件的记忆化失效？

goal.en: Separate supported loading boundaries from rendering failures.
goal.zh: 区分受支持的加载边界与渲染失败。

check.en: Does wrapping an ordinary effect fetch in Suspense automatically show its fallback?
check.zh: 用 Suspense 包裹普通 effect 请求，会自动显示加载占位吗？

goal.en: Subscribe to external state through a consistent snapshot contract.
goal.zh: 通过一致的快照约束订阅外部状态。

check.en: Why is reading a mutable global during render not a subscription?
check.zh: 为什么渲染时读取可变全局变量不等于订阅？

goal.en: Review a backwards-compatible change to an editable customer-facing interface and identify failure recovery evidence.
goal.zh: 评审可编辑的用户界面的向后兼容变更，并明确失败恢复证据。

check.en: What must remain compatible during rollout, and what evidence justifies rollback?
check.zh: 逐步发布期间哪些行为必须兼容，什么证据足以触发回滚？

description.en: From useful annotations to modeling reliable application boundaries.
description.zh: 从类型标注到可靠的业务建模与接口边界。

prerequisite.en: Comfortable writing JavaScript; React experience is helpful.
prerequisite.zh: 能编写 JavaScript；有 React 经验可直接从薄弱点开始。

project.en: Type an existing JavaScript utility without weakening it with any.
project.zh: 为已有 JavaScript 工具补充类型，避免依赖 any。

goal.en: Decide when inference is enough and when an explicit contract helps.
goal.zh: 判断何时依赖推断，何时需要显式约束。

check.en: If a variable starts as a literal, when does its inferred type widen?
check.zh: 变量从字面量初始化时，类型什么时候会被拓宽？

goal.en: Use control flow to work safely with multiple possible types.
goal.zh: 通过控制流安全处理多种可能的类型。

check.en: How would you handle string | number without a type assertion?
check.zh: 如何处理 string | number，而不靠类型断言？

goal.en: Describe object shapes, optional properties, and readonly intent.
goal.zh: 描述对象结构、可选属性与只读意图。

check.en: Does readonly make a received object immutable at runtime?
check.zh: readonly 会让收到的对象在运行时不可变吗？

goal.en: Validate unknown input and distinguish unchecked values from unreachable states.
goal.zh: 校验未知输入，区分绕过检查的值和不可能的状态。

check.en: Why is assigning a JSON response a type not the same as validating it?
check.zh: 为什么给 JSON 响应标注类型不等于校验数据？

goal.en: Handle missing values without non-null assertions.
goal.zh: 无需非空断言即可处理缺失值。

check.en: How does an optional property differ from a required property accepting undefined?
check.zh: 可选属性与允许 undefined 的必填属性有何区别？

goal.en: Validate configurations while retaining useful inferred types.
goal.zh: 校验配置，同时保留有用的推断类型。

check.en: How can satisfies check a map without replacing its inferred shape?
check.zh: satisfies 如何检查映射而不替换推断结构？

goal.en: Reason about assignability and excess-property checking.
goal.zh: 理解可赋值性与多余属性检查。

check.en: Why can a variable assignment accept extra fields that an object literal rejects?
check.zh: 为什么变量赋值可能接受对象字面量被拒绝的额外字段？

goal.en: Define observable acceptance cases for an editable customer-facing interface using TypeScript.
goal.zh: 为基于 TypeScript 的可编辑的用户界面定义可观测验收用例。

check.en: Which empty, invalid, and duplicate-input cases belong in the acceptance contract?
check.zh: 验收约束应包含哪些空值、非法输入与重复输入场景？

project.en: Model a request flow with loading, success, and failure states.
project.zh: 建模一个包含加载、成功和失败的请求流程。

goal.en: Preserve relationships between input and output types.
goal.zh: 保留输入与输出类型之间的关系。

check.en: What information does returning any lose compared with returning T?
check.zh: 与返回 T 相比，返回 any 丢失了什么关系？

goal.en: Build helpers that accept only valid object keys.
goal.zh: 让工具函数只接受合法的对象键。

check.en: How do you tie a key argument to the type of its returned value?
check.zh: 如何让键参数和返回值的类型保持对应？

title.zh: 可辨识联合与穷尽检查

goal.en: Represent valid business states instead of unrelated boolean flags.
goal.zh: 用合法业务状态替代互不约束的布尔标记。

check.en: What breaks when a new state is added to an exhaustive switch?
check.zh: 给穷尽 switch 新增一种状态时，哪里应该暴露遗漏？

goal.en: Model callback inputs and choose a union or overload deliberately.
goal.zh: 定义回调输入，并合理选择联合类型或重载。

check.en: When is one union parameter simpler than several overloads?
check.zh: 什么时候一个联合类型参数比多个重载更简单？

goal.en: Model Promise results and explicitly handle unknown failures.
goal.zh: 建模 Promise 结果，并明确处理未知错误。

check.en: Does Promise<User> guarantee rejection contains an Error?
check.zh: Promise<User> 能保证拒绝值一定是 Error 吗？

goal.en: Implement runtime checks that justify a narrowing claim.
goal.zh: 实现足以支持类型收窄的运行时检查。

check.en: What goes wrong if isUser only checks that a value is an object?
check.zh: isUser 只检查对象类型会出现什么问题？

goal.en: Preserve prop relationships and event payload types.
goal.zh: 保留属性间关系与事件载荷类型。

check.en: How can a union prevent an href-only property on a button variant?
check.zh: 如何用联合类型禁止按钮变体接收专属于链接的 href？

goal.en: Protect an editable customer-facing interface with one valid case, one broken implementation, and an independent changed-input case.
goal.zh: 为可编辑的用户界面提供正确用例、错误实现与独立变更输入用例。

check.en: What test would fail for a plausible broken implementation but pass for the intended behavior?
check.zh: 什么测试能让合理但错误的实现失败，并让预期行为通过？

project.en: Design typed API boundaries with runtime validation and a strict build.
project.zh: 设计带运行时校验和严格编译检查的 API 边界。

goal.en: Derive related contracts with Pick, Omit, Partial, and mapped types.
goal.zh: 用 Pick、Omit、Partial 和映射类型派生相关约束。

check.en: Why can Partial<T> be too permissive for a real update command?
check.zh: 为什么 Partial<T> 可能不足以约束真实的更新命令？

goal.en: Transform types while checking distribution over unions.
goal.zh: 转换类型，并理解联合类型上的分布行为。

check.en: How does a conditional type behave differently on a union?
check.zh: 条件类型遇到联合类型时，分布行为会怎样影响结果？

title.zh: 静态检查与运行时边界

goal.en: Keep assertions separate from validation at network and storage boundaries.
goal.zh: 在网络和存储边界区分断言与真实校验。

check.en: Can a value asserted as User still lack an id at runtime?
check.zh: 被断言为 User 的值，运行时仍可能没有 id 吗？

goal.en: Understand strict options and match module settings to the runtime.
goal.zh: 理解严格检查，并让模块配置匹配实际运行环境。

check.en: Why might a file type-check but fail to load in Node?
check.zh: 为什么文件通过类型检查，却无法在 Node 中加载？

goal.en: Describe external modules without concealing runtime behavior.
goal.zh: 描述外部模块，不掩盖运行时行为。

check.en: Can a declaration make a missing runtime export exist?
check.zh: 声明文件能让不存在的运行时导出出现吗？

goal.en: Check function parameter compatibility at API boundaries.
goal.zh: 在 API 边界检查函数参数兼容性。

check.en: Why is a dog-only callback unsafe where any animal may be passed?
check.zh: 允许传入任意动物的位置，为什么不能接收仅处理狗的回调？

goal.en: Protect public contracts with compile-time positive and negative examples.
goal.zh: 通过正反编译示例保护公共约束。

check.en: How can @ts-expect-error expose a restriction that accidentally disappeared?
check.zh: @ts-expect-error 如何发现意外消失的类型限制？

goal.en: Review a backwards-compatible change to an editable customer-facing interface and identify failure recovery evidence.
goal.zh: 评审可编辑的用户界面的向后兼容变更，并明确失败恢复证据。

check.en: What must remain compatible during rollout, and what evidence justifies rollback?
check.zh: 逐步发布期间哪些行为必须兼容，什么证据足以触发回滚？

description.en: Semantic, accessible pages and layouts that survive real content.
description.zh: 有语义、可访问，并能适应真实内容的页面与布局。

prerequisite.en: No framework required; use browser developer tools.
prerequisite.zh: 不依赖框架，配合浏览器开发者工具学习。

project.en: Build an accessible article page and form using native HTML.
project.zh: 用原生 HTML 编写可访问的文章页和表单。

goal.en: Choose elements by meaning, not their default appearance.
goal.zh: 按内容含义选择元素，而非默认外观。

check.en: When should an action use a button instead of a link?
check.zh: 一次操作什么时候应该用 button，而不是链接？

goal.en: Connect labels, input types, validation, and submission behavior.
goal.zh: 关联标签、输入类型、校验与提交行为。

check.en: What happens when a button inside a form has no explicit type?
check.zh: 表单内的按钮没有显式 type 时，可能触发什么行为？

goal.en: Reason about content, padding, borders, and box-sizing.
goal.zh: 区分内容、内边距、边框与 box-sizing。

check.en: A 200px box has 20px padding and 2px borders: how does border-box change its total width?
check.zh: 200px 宽的盒子有 20px 内边距和 2px 边框，border-box 怎样改变总宽度？

goal.en: Explain why a declaration wins before adding !important.
goal.zh: 先解释规则为什么生效，再考虑 !important。

check.en: Can a more specific selector lose because of cascade layers?
check.zh: 选择器更具体，仍可能因为层叠层而失效吗？

goal.en: Build meaningful headings, landmarks, and link destinations.
goal.zh: 建立合理标题、地标与链接目标。

check.en: Why should heading levels reflect document hierarchy rather than font size?
check.zh: 为什么标题层级应表达文档结构，而非字号？

goal.en: Choose image sizes and reserve layout space.
goal.zh: 选择图片尺寸，并预留布局空间。

check.en: How do width and height attributes help prevent layout shifts?
check.zh: width 和 height 属性如何减少布局偏移？

goal.en: Design visible keyboard focus and consistent disabled states.
goal.zh: 设计可见的键盘焦点与一致的禁用状态。

check.en: Why is removing outlines without a replacement harmful?
check.zh: 为什么移除轮廓却不提供替代焦点样式会有问题？

goal.en: Define observable acceptance cases for an editable customer-facing interface using HTML & CSS.
goal.zh: 为基于 HTML 与 CSS 的可编辑的用户界面定义可观测验收用例。

check.en: Which empty, invalid, and duplicate-input cases belong in the acceptance contract?
check.zh: 验收约束应包含哪些空值、非法输入与重复输入场景？

project.en: Build a responsive dashboard with long text and unpredictable data.
project.zh: 搭建能适应长文本和不固定数据的响应式仪表盘。

goal.en: Control one-dimensional alignment and intrinsic minimum sizes.
goal.zh: 控制一维对齐，并理解元素的固有最小尺寸。

check.en: Why can a flex child overflow until min-width is set to 0?
check.zh: 为什么 flex 子项可能需要 min-width: 0 才不溢出？

goal.en: Choose grid tracks that fit content without accidental overflow.
goal.zh: 选择适应内容且不意外溢出的网格轨道。

check.en: How can minmax(0, 1fr) differ from 1fr for long content?
check.zh: 长内容下，minmax(0, 1fr) 与 1fr 有什么区别？

goal.en: Find containing blocks and understand stacking contexts.
goal.zh: 找到定位包含块，理解层叠上下文。

check.en: Why can a very large z-index still fail to cover another element?
check.zh: 为什么 z-index 很大，仍然盖不住另一个元素？

goal.en: Adapt layouts to content, viewport, and readable text sizes.
goal.zh: 让布局适应内容、视口与可读的字号。

check.en: How does a layout behave when text grows rather than the viewport shrinking?
check.zh: 如果字号增大，而不是视口缩小，布局会怎样变化？

goal.en: Adapt components to their available container space.
goal.zh: 根据组件容器的可用空间调整布局。

check.en: Why can a viewport breakpoint fail for a card inside a narrow sidebar?
check.zh: 视口断点为什么可能不适合窄侧栏中的卡片？

goal.en: Handle long words, zoom, and variable-height content.
goal.zh: 处理长单词、缩放与不固定高度的内容。

check.en: How should an action row behave when labels double in length?
check.zh: 操作按钮文字长度翻倍后，布局应该如何适应？

goal.en: Manage modal focus, dismissal, and accessible names.
goal.zh: 管理模态焦点、关闭行为与可访问名称。

check.en: Where should keyboard focus go when a modal opens and closes?
check.zh: 模态框打开和关闭时，键盘焦点应如何移动？

goal.en: Protect an editable customer-facing interface with one valid case, one broken implementation, and an independent changed-input case.
goal.zh: 为可编辑的用户界面提供正确用例、错误实现与独立变更输入用例。

check.en: What test would fail for a plausible broken implementation but pass for the intended behavior?
check.zh: 什么测试能让合理但错误的实现失败，并让预期行为通过？

project.en: Audit a small component library for keyboard use, readability, and layout stability.
project.zh: 检查小型组件库的键盘操作、可读性与布局稳定性。

goal.en: Preserve focus, names, and native interaction semantics.
goal.zh: 保留焦点、可访问名称与原生交互语义。

check.en: Can a clickable div be used with only a keyboard by default?
check.zh: 一个可点击的 div 默认能只靠键盘操作吗？

goal.en: Balance size, contrast, line height, and reading width.
goal.zh: 协调字号、对比度、行高和阅读行宽。

check.en: Why can larger text remain hard to read on a low-contrast background?
check.zh: 为什么文字放大后，在低对比度背景上仍然难读？

goal.en: Distinguish layout, paint, and compositing when diagnosing motion.
goal.zh: 诊断动画时区分布局、绘制与合成。

check.en: What should you measure before assuming a transform animation is cheap?
check.zh: 认定 transform 动画开销小之前，应该测量什么？

goal.en: Use scoped rules and custom properties without specificity escalation.
goal.zh: 用清晰作用域和自定义属性组织样式，避免优先级失控。

check.en: How do you change a theme without overriding every component rule?
check.zh: 如何切换主题，而不用覆盖每个组件的规则？

goal.en: Keep essential content usable when optional features fail.
goal.zh: 可选功能失败时，仍让核心内容可用。

check.en: What should remain usable if a decorative animation cannot load?
check.zh: 装饰动画无法加载时，哪些功能仍应可用？

goal.en: Respect reduced-motion and color-scheme preferences.
goal.zh: 尊重减少动画与配色偏好。

check.en: How can motion be reduced without hiding completion feedback?
check.zh: 如何减少动画，同时保留完成反馈？

goal.en: Diagnose feature support with targeted fallbacks.
goal.zh: 通过针对性回退处理特性支持差异。

check.en: How can @supports isolate an enhancement from a baseline layout?
check.zh: @supports 如何将增强效果与基础布局隔离？

goal.en: Review a backwards-compatible change to an editable customer-facing interface and identify failure recovery evidence.
goal.zh: 评审可编辑的用户界面的向后兼容变更，并明确失败恢复证据。

check.en: What must remain compatible during rollout, and what evidence justifies rollback?
check.zh: 逐步发布期间哪些行为必须兼容，什么证据足以触发回滚？

description.en: From C# fundamentals to reliable, observable web APIs.
description.zh: 从 C# 基础到可靠、可观测的 Web API。

prerequisite.en: Basic programming and HTTP concepts.
prerequisite.zh: 具备基本编程和 HTTP 概念。

project.en: Build a command-line task tracker.
project.zh: 编写命令行任务管理工具。

goal.en: Distinguish value copies, references, and nullable contracts.
goal.zh: 区分值复制、引用与可空约束。

check.en: Does copying a List variable copy its items?
check.zh: 复制 List 变量会复制其中的元素吗？

goal.en: Choose lists, dictionaries, and generic contracts.
goal.zh: 选择列表、字典和泛型约束。

check.en: When would a dictionary improve repeated lookups?
check.zh: 反复查找时，字典何时更合适？

goal.en: Handle failure and release disposable resources with using.
goal.zh: 处理失败，并用 using 释放可释放资源。

check.en: Does garbage collection guarantee timely file-handle release?
check.zh: 垃圾回收能保证及时释放文件句柄吗？

goal.en: Separate query construction from enumeration.
goal.zh: 区分查询构建与实际枚举。

check.en: What can change if an IEnumerable query is enumerated twice?
check.zh: 对 IEnumerable 查询枚举两次，结果或成本可能怎样变化？

goal.en: Distinguish compiler annotations from runtime validation.
goal.zh: 区分编译器标注与运行时校验。

check.en: Can a non-nullable DTO property still receive invalid external input?
check.zh: 非空 DTO 属性仍可能接收到非法外部输入吗？

goal.en: Recognize query enumeration and materialization boundaries.
goal.zh: 识别查询枚举与物化边界。

check.en: Why can enumerating a query twice repeat database work?
check.zh: 为什么两次枚举查询可能重复访问数据库？

goal.en: Release owned resources with using and async disposal.
goal.zh: 用 using 与异步释放管理自有资源。

check.en: Who should dispose a dependency created by the DI container?
check.zh: 由 DI 容器创建的依赖应该由谁释放？

goal.en: Define observable acceptance cases for an order-processing service using C# & .NET.
goal.zh: 为基于 C# 与 .NET 的订单处理服务定义可观测验收用例。

check.en: Which empty, invalid, and duplicate-input cases belong in the acceptance contract?
check.zh: 验收约束应包含哪些空值、非法输入与重复输入场景？

project.en: Build a validated, cancellable task API.
project.zh: 搭建支持校验和取消的任务 API。

goal.en: Compose asynchronous I/O and propagate cancellation.
goal.zh: 组合异步 I/O，并传递取消信号。

check.en: Why can .Result be harmful inside a request handler?
check.zh: 请求处理器中使用 .Result 为什么可能有害？

goal.en: Trace requests through ordered middleware.
goal.zh: 追踪请求经过有序中间件的过程。

check.en: What changes when authentication and authorization middleware are reordered?
check.zh: 认证与授权中间件顺序改变会有什么影响？

goal.en: Match singleton, scoped, and transient lifetimes to ownership.
goal.zh: 按资源归属选择单例、作用域与瞬态生命周期。

check.en: Why is capturing a scoped service in a singleton risky?
check.zh: 单例捕获作用域服务为什么有风险？

goal.en: Validate input and check access to individual resources.
goal.zh: 校验输入，并检查具体资源的访问权限。

check.en: Does an authenticated user automatically own the requested record?
check.zh: 已登录用户就一定有权访问请求的记录吗？

goal.en: Order middleware around authentication and error handling.
goal.zh: 围绕身份认证和错误处理安排中间件顺序。

check.en: Why can middleware order change whether an error is caught?
check.zh: 中间件顺序为什么影响错误能否被捕获？

goal.en: Avoid accidental N+1 reads and unnecessary tracking.
goal.zh: 避免意外 N+1 查询与不必要的跟踪。

check.en: When can a projected read benefit from AsNoTracking?
check.zh: 投影读取何时可以受益于 AsNoTracking？

goal.en: Propagate cancellation across requests and data access.
goal.zh: 跨请求与数据访问传递取消信号。

check.en: Why is accepting CancellationToken insufficient if it is never passed onward?
check.zh: 接收 CancellationToken 却不继续传递，为什么不起作用？

goal.en: Protect an order-processing service with one valid case, one broken implementation, and an independent changed-input case.
goal.zh: 为订单处理服务提供正确用例、错误实现与独立变更输入用例。

check.en: What test would fail for a plausible broken implementation but pass for the intended behavior?
check.zh: 什么测试能让合理但错误的实现失败，并让预期行为通过？

project.en: Add persistence, integration tests, and diagnostics to the API.
project.zh: 为 API 添加持久化、集成测试与诊断。

goal.en: Inspect tracking, generated SQL, and N+1 queries.
goal.zh: 检查跟踪、生成的 SQL 与 N+1 查询。

check.en: How can a loop over navigation properties multiply database requests?
check.zh: 遍历导航属性为什么可能增加数据库请求次数？

goal.en: Protect multi-step changes and detect conflicting writes.
goal.zh: 保护多步骤修改，并识别并发写入冲突。

check.en: How would you prevent two requests from silently overwriting one record?
check.zh: 如何避免两个请求悄悄覆盖同一条记录？

goal.en: Test the HTTP boundary and persistence behavior together.
goal.zh: 联合验证 HTTP 边界和持久化行为。

check.en: Which database failures can mocked repository tests miss?
check.zh: 模拟仓储的测试可能漏掉哪些数据库问题？

goal.en: Use traces, metrics, and allocation evidence before optimizing.
goal.zh: 先用追踪、指标与分配证据定位问题，再优化。

check.en: How would you distinguish CPU pressure from slow external I/O?
check.zh: 如何区分 CPU 压力和外部 I/O 缓慢？

goal.en: Detect conflicting updates instead of silently overwriting.
goal.zh: 检测更新冲突，避免静默覆盖。

check.en: How should an API respond when its row version is stale?
check.zh: 行版本已过期时，API 应如何响应？

goal.en: Bound retries and scope dependencies in background workers.
goal.zh: 限制重试，并管理后台工作器中的依赖作用域。

check.en: Why should a singleton worker not capture a scoped DbContext?
check.zh: 为什么单例工作器不应长期持有作用域 DbContext？

title.zh: 结构化日志与链路追踪

goal.en: Correlate requests without logging secrets.
goal.zh: 关联请求，并避免记录敏感信息。

check.en: How do you connect an HTTP failure to the downstream database span?
check.zh: 如何关联 HTTP 失败与下游数据库追踪片段？

goal.en: Review a backwards-compatible change to an order-processing service and identify failure recovery evidence.
goal.zh: 评审订单处理服务的向后兼容变更，并明确失败恢复证据。

check.en: What must remain compatible during rollout, and what evidence justifies rollback?
check.zh: 逐步发布期间哪些行为必须兼容，什么证据足以触发回滚？

description.en: Understand the runtime, build reliable services, and diagnose asynchronous workloads.
description.zh: 理解运行机制，构建可靠服务，诊断异步与性能问题。

prerequisite.en: JavaScript functions, objects, Promises, and basic HTTP. Exercises assume Node.js 24 unless stated otherwise.
prerequisite.zh: 具备 JavaScript 函数、对象、Promise 与基本 HTTP 知识；题目默认使用 Node.js 24，特殊假设会单独说明。

project.en: Build a small command-line utility with validated configuration and asynchronous input.
project.zh: 编写具备配置校验和异步输入处理的小型命令行工具。

goal.en: Distinguish Node globals from browser APIs and validate environment configuration.
goal.zh: 区分 Node 与浏览器 API，并校验环境配置。

check.en: An environment variable contains "false": why is Boolean(value) not a valid boolean parser?
check.zh: 环境变量值为 "false" 时，为什么不能直接用 Boolean(value) 解析？

goal.en: Choose module boundaries deliberately and understand exports, loading, and caching.
goal.zh: 合理选择模块边界，理解导出、加载与缓存。

check.en: How do package.json type, .mjs, and .cjs affect how a file is interpreted?
check.zh: package.json 的 type、.mjs 与 .cjs 如何影响模块解释方式？

goal.en: Await asynchronous work and propagate rejection through the correct boundary.
goal.zh: 正确等待异步任务，并将拒绝传递到正确的错误边界。

check.en: Why can try/catch miss the rejection of a Promise returned without await?
check.zh: 没有 await 的 Promise 拒绝，为什么可能绕过当前 try/catch？

goal.en: Handle asynchronous file data, encodings, and path resolution without blocking a request.
goal.zh: 处理异步文件数据、编码与路径解析，避免阻塞请求。

check.en: How does resolving a relative path from the working directory differ from resolving it from the module location?
check.zh: 相对路径从工作目录解析，与从模块所在位置解析，有什么不同？

goal.en: Distinguish asynchronous I/O from CPU-bound JavaScript.
goal.zh: 区分异步 I/O 与 CPU 密集型 JavaScript。

check.en: Why does putting a large loop in an async function still block requests?
check.zh: 为什么把大循环放进 async 函数仍会阻塞请求？

goal.en: Validate request paths, payload sizes, and encodings.
goal.zh: 校验请求路径、载荷大小与编码。

check.en: Why should a server reject oversized bodies before parsing JSON?
check.zh: 为什么服务应在解析 JSON 前拒绝超大请求体？

goal.en: Expose deliberate module entry points and pin reproducible installs.
goal.zh: 明确模块入口，并固定可复现安装。

check.en: Why can importing an internal file break after a dependency update?
check.zh: 为什么导入包内部文件可能在依赖更新后失效？

goal.en: Define observable acceptance cases for an order-processing service using Node.js.
goal.zh: 为基于 Node.js 的订单处理服务定义可观测验收用例。

check.en: Which empty, invalid, and duplicate-input cases belong in the acceptance contract?
check.zh: 验收约束应包含哪些空值、非法输入与重复输入场景？

project.en: Design and test a small HTTP service with explicit error and resource boundaries.
project.zh: 设计并测试一个具有明确错误与资源边界的小型 HTTP 服务。

goal.en: Reason about asynchronous scheduling while specifying callback and module context.
goal.zh: 明确回调与模块上下文，再推导异步调度顺序。

check.en: Why is it unsafe to promise a universal order between top-level setTimeout(0) and setImmediate?
check.zh: 为什么不能断言顶层 setTimeout(0) 与 setImmediate 总有固定顺序？

goal.en: Handle methods, paths, status codes, and bounded request bodies.
goal.zh: 处理方法、路径、状态码与有大小限制的请求体。

check.en: Why must a request handler stop its control flow after sending the final response?
check.zh: 发送最终响应后，为什么要结束当前处理分支？

goal.en: Manage listener ownership and distinguish synchronous events from asynchronous work.
goal.zh: 管理监听器生命周期，区分同步事件派发与异步任务。

check.en: If an async listener rejects, what error-handling assumption could leave the failure unobserved?
check.zh: 异步监听器拒绝时，哪种错误处理假设可能使失败无人接管？

goal.en: Test success and failure with injected dependencies instead of real services.
goal.zh: 通过依赖注入验证成功与失败，减少对真实服务的依赖。

check.en: How can a test finish successfully before an unawaited assertion in an async callback runs?
check.zh: 没有等待异步回调时，为什么测试可能在断言执行前就显示成功？

goal.en: Bound outbound requests and distinguish connection failures.
goal.zh: 限制出站请求时间，并区分连接失败。

check.en: Why can an unbounded downstream request exhaust a service?
check.zh: 为什么无超时的下游请求可能耗尽服务资源？

title.zh: 工作线程与 CPU 任务

goal.en: Move suitable CPU work off the event loop.
goal.zh: 将适合的 CPU 工作移出事件循环。

check.en: When can worker startup and transfer cost exceed its benefit?
check.zh: 工作线程启动和数据传输成本何时可能超过收益？

title.zh: Node 测试隔离与 I/O 注入

goal.en: Test behavior through explicit clocks and I/O dependencies.
goal.zh: 通过明确时钟和 I/O 依赖测试行为。

check.en: How can an injected clock remove a flaky timeout test?
check.zh: 注入时钟如何消除不稳定的超时测试？

goal.en: Protect an order-processing service with one valid case, one broken implementation, and an independent changed-input case.
goal.zh: 为订单处理服务提供正确用例、错误实现与独立变更输入用例。

check.en: What test would fail for a plausible broken implementation but pass for the intended behavior?
check.zh: 什么测试能让合理但错误的实现失败，并让预期行为通过？

project.en: Make a data-processing service bounded, cancellable, and observable.
project.zh: 让数据处理服务具备流量边界、取消能力与可观测性。

goal.en: Respect writable backpressure and propagate pipeline failures.
goal.zh: 遵守可写流的背压信号，并传递管道错误。

check.en: What happens to memory if a producer keeps writing after write() returns false?
check.zh: write() 返回 false 后仍持续写入，可能如何影响内存？

title.zh: 并发控制与 Worker 线程

goal.en: Bound concurrent I/O and move suitable CPU work off the main event loop.
goal.zh: 限制并发 I/O，将合适的 CPU 密集工作移出主事件循环。

check.en: Why does wrapping a CPU-heavy loop in an async function not make it non-blocking?
check.zh: 为什么给 CPU 密集循环套上 async 函数，并不会让它不阻塞？

goal.en: Propagate AbortSignal and release resources on success, failure, and cancellation.
goal.zh: 传递 AbortSignal，并在成功、失败、取消时释放资源。

check.en: Does rejecting a timeout Promise automatically stop the underlying operation?
check.zh: 超时 Promise 被拒绝后，底层任务就一定停止了吗？

goal.en: Use timing, event-loop delay, and memory evidence to locate bottlenecks.
goal.zh: 结合耗时、事件循环延迟与内存证据定位瓶颈。

check.en: How would you distinguish blocked event-loop time from waiting on a slow dependency?
check.zh: 如何区分事件循环被阻塞，与等待慢依赖造成的延迟？

goal.en: Stop accepting work and drain bounded in-flight tasks.
goal.zh: 停止接收新任务，并在限定时间内完成进行中的工作。

check.en: What happens if a process exits before pending writes finish?
check.zh: 待完成写入结束前退出进程会怎样？

goal.en: Locate retained objects with measurements instead of guesses.
goal.zh: 通过测量定位被保留对象，而非猜测。

check.en: How can an unbounded Map retain every completed request?
check.zh: 无限增长的 Map 如何保留所有已完成请求？

goal.en: Bound transient retries and prevent cascading overload.
goal.zh: 限制瞬时故障重试，防止级联过载。

check.en: Why can retrying every failure immediately worsen an outage?
check.zh: 为什么立刻重试所有失败可能加重故障？

goal.en: Review a backwards-compatible change to an order-processing service and identify failure recovery evidence.
goal.zh: 评审订单处理服务的向后兼容变更，并明确失败恢复证据。

check.en: What must remain compatible during rollout, and what evidence justifies rollback?
check.zh: 逐步发布期间哪些行为必须兼容，什么证据足以触发回滚？

description.en: Build typed domain models, reliable services, and concurrent Java programs.
description.zh: 从类型与领域建模，到可靠服务、并发与 JVM 诊断。

prerequisite.en: Basic programming and HTTP. Exercises use Java 21, standard libraries, and no preview features.
prerequisite.zh: 具备基本编程与 HTTP 知识。题目采用 Java 21 标准库，不使用预览特性。

project.en: Build a validated task model.
project.zh: 建立经过校验的任务模型。

goal.en: Handle primitives, wrappers, and nullable values explicitly.
goal.zh: 明确处理基本类型、包装类型与空值。

check.en: What happens when a null Integer is unboxed?
check.zh: 对 null Integer 自动拆箱会发生什么？

goal.en: Model data and protect mutable state at object boundaries.
goal.zh: 通过对象边界封装数据与可变状态。

check.en: Does a record containing a mutable list make the list immutable?
check.zh: record 持有可变列表时，列表也会不可变吗？

goal.en: Choose collections and implement consistent equality contracts.
goal.zh: 选择集合并遵守相等性契约。

check.en: Why must equal objects have equal hash codes in a HashSet?
check.zh: HashSet 中相等对象为什么必须有相同哈希值？

goal.en: Propagate failures and close resources with try-with-resources.
goal.zh: 传递异常并使用 try-with-resources 释放资源。

check.en: Who closes a resource when processing throws an exception?
check.zh: 处理过程中发生异常时，资源由谁关闭？

goal.en: Keep equals and hashCode consistent for collection keys.
goal.zh: 保证集合键的 equals 与 hashCode 一致。

check.en: Why can mutating a key make a HashMap lookup fail?
check.zh: 修改键为什么可能让 HashMap 查询失败？

goal.en: Close owned resources even when exceptions occur.
goal.zh: 发生异常时也正确关闭自有资源。

check.en: What happens to an open stream when the body throws?
check.zh: 代码主体抛出异常时，打开的流如何关闭？

goal.en: Use producer and consumer bounds deliberately.
goal.zh: 合理使用生产者与消费者边界。

check.en: Why can List<? extends Number> not safely accept an Integer append?
check.zh: 为什么 List<? extends Number> 不能安全追加 Integer？

goal.en: Define observable acceptance cases for an order-processing service using Java.
goal.zh: 为基于 Java 的订单处理服务定义可观测验收用例。

check.en: Which empty, invalid, and duplicate-input cases belong in the acceptance contract?
check.zh: 验收约束应包含哪些空值、非法输入与重复输入场景？

project.en: Build a testable service boundary.
project.zh: 构建可测试的服务边界。

goal.en: Use bounded generics and wildcards for type-safe APIs.
goal.zh: 使用有界泛型和通配符建立类型安全接口。

check.en: Why can a List<Integer> not be assigned to List<Number>?
check.zh: 为什么 List<Integer> 不能赋给 List<Number>？

goal.en: Transform data without hidden shared-state side effects.
goal.zh: 避免隐式共享状态副作用，完成数据转换。

check.en: Why should stream transformations avoid mutating an external list?
check.zh: 流转换为什么应避免修改外部列表？

goal.en: Test observable behavior with injected clocks and repositories.
goal.zh: 注入时钟与仓储，测试可观察行为。

check.en: How can expiry logic be tested without sleeping?
check.zh: 如何不等待真实时间就验证过期逻辑？

goal.en: Map validation, domain failures, and responses explicitly.
goal.zh: 明确映射校验、领域错误与响应。

check.en: Should malformed input and a missing resource return the same result?
check.zh: 无效输入和资源不存在应该返回同一种结果吗？

goal.en: Distinguish pipeline construction from terminal evaluation.
goal.zh: 区分流水线建立与终止求值。

check.en: Why may a stream map function not execute without a terminal operation?
check.zh: 为什么没有终止操作时 map 函数可能不执行？

goal.en: Commit related changes atomically and roll back failures.
goal.zh: 原子提交相关变更，并回滚失败。

check.en: How can auto-commit split a two-step transfer into partial success?
check.zh: 自动提交如何让两步转账出现部分成功？

goal.en: Separate visibility from atomic compound operations.
goal.zh: 区分可见性与复合操作的原子性。

check.en: Does volatile make count++ atomic?
check.zh: volatile 能让 count++ 变为原子操作吗？

goal.en: Protect an order-processing service with one valid case, one broken implementation, and an independent changed-input case.
goal.zh: 为订单处理服务提供正确用例、错误实现与独立变更输入用例。

check.en: What test would fail for a plausible broken implementation but pass for the intended behavior?
check.zh: 什么测试能让合理但错误的实现失败，并让预期行为通过？

project.en: Design a bounded concurrent service.
project.zh: 设计资源有界的并发服务。

title.zh: 线程、虚拟线程与共享状态

goal.en: Separate task concurrency from shared-state synchronization.
goal.zh: 区分任务并发与共享状态同步。

check.en: Do virtual threads make a shared counter increment atomic?
check.zh: 虚拟线程会让共享计数器自增自动具备原子性吗？

goal.en: Compose asynchronous work and preserve failure boundaries.
goal.zh: 组合异步任务并保留失败边界。

check.en: Does timing out a future guarantee its underlying work has stopped?
check.zh: Future 超时是否保证底层任务已经停止？

goal.en: Use parameters and explicit transaction boundaries.
goal.zh: 使用参数化查询与明确的事务边界。

check.en: How do you prevent a partially applied two-step update?
check.zh: 如何避免两步更新只成功一步？

goal.en: Use allocation, reachability, and timing evidence to diagnose problems.
goal.zh: 根据分配、可达性与耗时证据诊断问题。

check.en: Why can reachable objects still cause unbounded memory growth?
check.zh: 对象仍然可达时，为什么也会造成内存无限增长？

title.zh: 虚拟线程与工作负载限制

goal.en: Bound downstream resources even with cheap threads.
goal.zh: 即使线程成本较低，也要限制下游资源用量。

check.en: Why can virtual threads still exhaust a database connection pool?
check.zh: 虚拟线程为什么仍可能耗尽数据库连接池？

goal.en: Measure allocation and pauses before tuning GC.
goal.zh: 调整 GC 前先测量分配与停顿。

check.en: What evidence distinguishes allocation pressure from retained-object growth?
check.zh: 什么证据能区分分配压力与保留对象增长？

goal.en: Evolve public contracts while protecting existing callers.
goal.zh: 演进公共约束，同时保护已有调用方。

check.en: Why can changing a return type break an already compiled client?
check.zh: 修改返回类型为什么可能破坏已编译客户端？

goal.en: Review a backwards-compatible change to an order-processing service and identify failure recovery evidence.
goal.zh: 评审订单处理服务的向后兼容变更，并明确失败恢复证据。

check.en: What must remain compatible during rollout, and what evidence justifies rollback?
check.zh: 逐步发布期间哪些行为必须兼容，什么证据足以触发回滚？

description.en: Write clear data transformations, testable tools, and asynchronous services.
description.zh: 编写清晰的数据转换、可测试工具与异步服务。

prerequisite.en: Basic programming. Exercises use Python 3.12 and the standard library, without third-party packages.
prerequisite.zh: 具备基本编程知识。题目采用 Python 3.12 标准库，不依赖第三方包。

project.en: Build a task-data transformation tool.
project.zh: 编写任务数据转换工具。

goal.en: Distinguish equality, identity, and shared mutable references.
goal.zh: 区分相等性、对象身份与共享可变引用。

check.en: Does copying a list also copy its nested dictionaries?
check.zh: 复制列表时，嵌套字典也会被复制吗？

check.en: Why is sanitizing stored text not a substitute for escaping HTML output?
check.zh: 为什么净化存储文本不能替代 HTML 输出转义？

goal.en: Define consistent editor and frontend design tokens.
goal.zh: 定义一致的编辑器与前端设计变量。

check.en: How can shared design settings prevent editor and frontend drift?
check.zh: 共享设计设置如何防止编辑器与前端样式偏离？

goal.en: Render the intended content and restore modified global context.
goal.zh: 渲染目标内容，并恢复修改后的全局上下文。

check.en: What can break after a custom loop leaves global post data changed?
check.zh: 自定义循环未恢复全局文章数据可能破坏什么？

goal.en: Define observable acceptance cases for an editable customer-facing interface using WordPress.
goal.zh: 为基于 WordPress 的可编辑的用户界面定义可观测验收用例。

check.en: Which empty, invalid, and duplicate-input cases belong in the acceptance contract?
check.zh: 验收约束应包含哪些空值、非法输入与重复输入场景？

project.en: Build a plugin for a custom content type and its editor.
project.zh: 为自定义内容类型与编辑界面编写插件。

goal.en: Separate activation setup from normal request handling.
goal.zh: 区分激活初始化与日常请求处理。

check.en: Why should permanent setup not run on every request?
check.zh: 为什么持久化初始化不应在每次请求时执行？

title.zh: 自定义文章类型与元数据

goal.en: Register content contracts and validate stored fields.
goal.zh: 注册内容约束，并校验存储字段。

check.en: What must be checked before saving a submitted custom field?
check.zh: 保存提交的自定义字段前应检查什么？

goal.en: Enqueue assets with explicit dependencies.
goal.zh: 声明依赖并通过队列加载资源。

check.en: Why can directly inserting script tags break dependency order?
check.zh: 直接插入 script 标签为什么可能破坏依赖顺序？

goal.en: Expose content with explicit permissions and pagination.
goal.zh: 通过明确权限与分页提供内容接口。

check.en: Why does a custom write endpoint need a permission callback?
check.zh: 为什么自定义写入端点需要权限回调？

goal.en: Choose saved markup or server rendering based on update behavior.
goal.zh: 根据更新行为选择保存标记或服务端渲染。

check.en: Why can stored block markup require a migration after its structure changes?
check.zh: 保存的区块标记结构变化后为什么可能需要迁移？

goal.en: Check capabilities for the specific object being changed.
goal.zh: 针对实际被修改对象检查权限。

check.en: Why is being logged in insufficient to edit another author’s draft?
check.zh: 已登录为什么不足以编辑其他作者的草稿？

goal.en: Make background jobs repeat-safe and observable.
goal.zh: 让后台任务可安全重复执行，并且可观测。

check.en: Why should a retried scheduled job not send the same receipt twice?
check.zh: 重试的计划任务为什么不能重复发送收据？

goal.en: Protect an editable customer-facing interface with one valid case, one broken implementation, and an independent changed-input case.
goal.zh: 为可编辑的用户界面提供正确用例、错误实现与独立变更输入用例。

check.en: What test would fail for a plausible broken implementation but pass for the intended behavior?
check.zh: 什么测试能让合理但错误的实现失败，并让预期行为通过？

project.en: Harden and deliver a plugin with a tested migration plan.
project.zh: 加固插件，并制定经过验证的迁移交付方案。

goal.en: Combine capability checks, CSRF protection, and contextual escaping.
goal.zh: 结合权限检查、CSRF 防护与按输出上下文转义。

check.en: Does a valid nonce prove a user can edit any post?
check.zh: 有效 nonce 能证明用户有权编辑任意文章吗？

goal.en: Use query APIs and prepared SQL where needed.
goal.zh: 优先使用查询 API，必要时使用预处理 SQL。

check.en: Why is concatenating user input into SQL unsafe?
check.zh: 将用户输入直接拼入 SQL 为什么不安全？

goal.en: Cache expensive reads and invalidate on relevant writes.
goal.zh: 缓存高成本读取，并在相关写入时失效。

check.en: How can a cached listing remain stale after publishing?
check.zh: 发布后缓存列表为什么可能仍显示旧内容？

goal.en: Verify backups and rehearse updates in staging.
goal.zh: 验证备份，并在预发布环境演练更新。

check.en: What evidence shows that a backup can actually restore the site?
check.zh: 什么证据能说明备份确实可以恢复站点？

title.zh: 插件兼容性与依赖约束

goal.en: Avoid global collisions and verify supported dependency versions.
goal.zh: 避免全局命名冲突，并验证依赖版本。

check.en: How can a global function name collide with another plugin?
check.zh: 全局函数名如何与另一个插件冲突？

goal.en: Separate public content caches from personalized responses.
goal.zh: 区分公共内容缓存与个性化响应。

check.en: What can leak if a private response is cached under only the URL?
check.zh: 私有响应仅按 URL 缓存会泄漏什么？

goal.en: Version stored data and make upgrades resumable.
goal.zh: 为存储数据设版本，并让升级可恢复。

check.en: What happens if an interrupted upgrade is run again?
check.zh: 中断的升级再次运行时应该怎样处理？

goal.en: Review a backwards-compatible change to an editable customer-facing interface and identify failure recovery evidence.
goal.zh: 评审可编辑的用户界面的向后兼容变更，并明确失败恢复证据。

check.en: What must remain compatible during rollout, and what evidence justifies rollback?
check.zh: 逐步发布期间哪些行为必须兼容，什么证据足以触发回滚？

description.en: Build accessible mobile interfaces and reliable native app workflows.
description.zh: 构建可访问的移动界面与可靠的原生应用流程。

prerequisite.en: JavaScript or TypeScript, React components, and state.
prerequisite.zh: 具备 JavaScript 或 TypeScript、React 组件与状态基础。

project.en: Build a mobile profile screen with editable fields.
project.zh: 构建带可编辑字段的移动个人资料页。

goal.en: Use View, Text, Image, and Pressable appropriately.
goal.zh: 合理使用 View、Text、Image 与 Pressable。

check.en: Why can a web div not replace a View in a native screen?
check.zh: 为什么原生页面不能直接用网页 div 替换 View？

goal.en: Build adaptive layouts using native styling rules.
goal.zh: 使用原生样式规则搭建自适应布局。

check.en: Which direction does a native flex container use by default?
check.zh: 原生 flex 容器默认沿哪个方向排列？

goal.en: Coordinate TextInput state and keyboard behavior.
goal.zh: 协调 TextInput 状态与键盘行为。

check.en: How does onChangeText differ from reading a browser input event?
check.zh: onChangeText 与读取浏览器输入事件有什么区别？

goal.en: Choose shared logic and explicit platform adaptations.
goal.zh: 区分共享逻辑与显式平台适配。

check.en: When should platform-specific files replace a conditional branch?
check.zh: 什么时候应使用平台专属文件替代条件分支？

goal.en: Distinguish simulator success from device behavior.
goal.zh: 区分模拟器成功与真实设备行为。

check.en: Why can an API reachable through localhost on a desktop fail on a phone?
check.zh: 桌面 localhost 可访问的 API，为什么手机可能访问失败？

goal.en: Keep controls usable around insets, rotation, and text scaling.
goal.zh: 在安全边距、旋转与文字缩放下保留可用控件。

check.en: Why can a bottom button be hidden by a system gesture area?
check.zh: 底部按钮为什么可能被系统手势区域遮挡？

goal.en: Provide reliable hit targets and disabled feedback.
goal.zh: 提供可靠触摸范围与禁用反馈。

check.en: Why can a visually large icon still have a small touch target?
check.zh: 视觉上很大的图标，为什么触摸范围仍可能很小？

goal.en: Define observable acceptance cases for an editable customer-facing interface using React Native.
goal.zh: 为基于 React Native 的可编辑的用户界面定义可观测验收用例。

check.en: Which empty, invalid, and duplicate-input cases belong in the acceptance contract?
check.zh: 验收约束应包含哪些空值、非法输入与重复输入场景？

project.en: Build a searchable list with details and a resilient data flow.
project.zh: 构建带详情页与可靠数据流程的可搜索列表。

goal.en: Render long lists with stable keys and explicit state.
goal.zh: 使用稳定键与明确状态渲染长列表。

check.en: Why can index keys break row state after reordering?
check.zh: 为什么使用索引作键可能在重排后破坏行状态？

goal.en: Handle loading, errors, and stale responses.
goal.zh: 处理加载、错误与过期响应。

check.en: How can a slower old request overwrite a newer search result?
check.zh: 较慢的旧请求如何覆盖新的搜索结果？

goal.en: Model routes, back behavior, and screen ownership.
goal.zh: 建模路由、返回行为与页面状态归属。

check.en: What should happen to unsaved input when a user goes back?
check.zh: 用户返回上一页时，未保存输入应如何处理？

goal.en: Provide labels and verify screen-reader focus.
goal.zh: 提供可访问标签，并验证读屏焦点。

check.en: How will a screen reader identify an icon-only action?
check.zh: 读屏如何识别只有图标的操作？

goal.en: Refresh stale state and release subscriptions appropriately.
goal.zh: 合理刷新过期状态，并释放订阅。

check.en: What should happen to a stale request when the app resumes?
check.zh: 应用恢复到前台时，过期请求应如何处理？

goal.en: Distinguish pending local edits from server-confirmed changes.
goal.zh: 区分本地待同步修改与服务端已确认变更。

check.en: How should a failed offline update appear after reconnection?
check.zh: 离线修改同步失败后，联网时应如何显示？

goal.en: Validate incoming route parameters and protected destinations.
goal.zh: 校验外部路由参数与受保护目标。

check.en: Why must a deep link not bypass authentication checks?
check.zh: 深链接为什么不能绕过身份验证？

goal.en: Protect an editable customer-facing interface with one valid case, one broken implementation, and an independent changed-input case.
goal.zh: 为可编辑的用户界面提供正确用例、错误实现与独立变更输入用例。

check.en: What test would fail for a plausible broken implementation but pass for the intended behavior?
check.zh: 什么测试能让合理但错误的实现失败，并让预期行为通过？

project.en: Prepare and validate a mobile app for release on real devices.
project.zh: 在真实设备上验证移动应用，并准备发布。

goal.en: Measure list rendering and JS work in release-like builds.
goal.zh: 在接近发布的构建中测量列表渲染与 JS 工作量。

check.en: Why can development-mode timing misrepresent release performance?
check.zh: 为什么开发模式的耗时不能代表发布性能？

goal.en: Respect native permission and module boundaries.
goal.zh: 遵守原生权限与模块边界。

check.en: How should a feature behave when permission is permanently denied?
check.zh: 权限被永久拒绝时，功能应如何表现？

goal.en: Combine logic tests with device-level interaction checks.
goal.zh: 结合逻辑测试与设备交互验证。

check.en: What can a component test miss about the on-screen keyboard?
check.zh: 组件测试可能遗漏屏幕键盘的哪些行为？

goal.en: Separate development settings from signed release builds.
goal.zh: 区分开发配置与已签名的发布构建。

check.en: What should you verify on a clean installation of a release build?
check.zh: 全新安装发布构建后应验证哪些内容？

title.zh: 敏感存储与令牌生命周期

goal.en: Separate ordinary preferences from credentials and revocation.
goal.zh: 区分普通偏好与凭证，并处理撤销。

check.en: Why should an authentication token not be treated as ordinary cached UI data?
check.zh: 为什么身份令牌不能作为普通界面缓存数据处理？

title.zh: 列表虚拟化与渲染稳定性

goal.en: Diagnose expensive rows using representative device data.
goal.zh: 通过有代表性的设备数据诊断高成本列表项。

check.en: Why can recreating every row prop worsen scrolling performance?
check.zh: 为什么重建每个列表项的属性可能拖慢滚动？

goal.en: Rebuild and test native changes across supported platforms.
goal.zh: 在受支持平台重新构建并测试原生变更。

check.en: Why can a JavaScript-only update not supply a missing native module?
check.zh: 为什么仅更新 JavaScript 无法补上缺失的原生模块？

goal.en: Review a backwards-compatible change to an editable customer-facing interface and identify failure recovery evidence.
goal.zh: 评审可编辑的用户界面的向后兼容变更，并明确失败恢复证据。

check.en: What must remain compatible during rollout, and what evidence justifies rollback?
check.zh: 逐步发布期间哪些行为必须兼容，什么证据足以触发回滚？

description.en: Design Azure workloads and deliver them through identity-aware, observable release pipelines.
description.zh: 设计 Azure 工作负载，通过明确身份与可观测的流水线交付。

prerequisite.en: Basic Git, HTTP, application configuration, and YAML. Cloud changes are reviewed as configuration here; real deployment requires a separate environment.
prerequisite.zh: 具备 Git、HTTP、应用配置与 YAML 基础；此处评审配置，真实部署需在独立环境验证。

project.en: Design a small App Service workload and a build-only YAML pipeline with explicit acceptance criteria.
project.zh: 设计小型 App Service 工作负载与只构建的 YAML 流水线，明确验收标准。

goal.en: Organize resources by ownership, lifecycle, and region.
goal.zh: 按归属、生命周期与区域组织资源。

check.en: Why is a resource group not itself a regional failover mechanism?
check.zh: 为什么资源组本身不是跨区域故障转移机制？

title.zh: Microsoft Entra ID 与 Azure RBAC

goal.en: Separate authentication from scoped resource authorization.
goal.zh: 区分身份认证与有作用域的资源授权。

check.en: Why should a build identity not receive subscription Owner?
check.zh: 为什么构建身份不应获得订阅 Owner 权限？

goal.en: Model allowed inbound and outbound paths explicitly.
goal.zh: 明确建模入站与出站允许路径。

check.en: What changes when a service is reachable only through a private network?
check.zh: 服务仅能通过私有网络访问后，哪些访问路径会改变？

goal.en: Choose compute based on execution and operational requirements.
goal.zh: 根据执行与运维要求选择计算服务。

check.en: What workload constraint would favor a long-running container over a request function?
check.zh: 什么工作负载约束可能更适合长运行容器而非请求函数？

goal.en: Separate public assets from private object access.
goal.zh: 区分公开资源与私有对象访问。

check.en: Why should a private upload not use an account-wide storage key in the browser?
check.zh: 私有上传为什么不能把账户级存储密钥放进浏览器？

goal.en: Keep secrets outside repositories and scoped to runtime needs.
goal.zh: 让密钥远离仓库，并限制运行时访问范围。

check.en: How should an app obtain a secret without embedding it in source?
check.zh: 应用如何在不将密钥写入源码的情况下获取密钥？

title.zh: 流水线阶段、作业与步骤

goal.en: Model a deterministic checkout, install, test, and build flow.
goal.zh: 建模确定的检出、安装、测试与构建流程。

check.en: Why must a failing test prevent a successful build stage from being released?
check.zh: 为什么测试失败必须阻止后续制品发布？

goal.en: Match agent trust, tooling, and network reachability.
goal.zh: 匹配代理信任、工具与网络可达性。

check.en: Why can a hosted agent fail to reach a private-only deployment endpoint?
check.zh: 托管代理为什么可能无法访问仅限私网的部署端点？

project.en: Specify test gates, publish an immutable artifact, and plan a staging release using a federated identity.
project.zh: 定义测试门禁、发布不可变制品，并使用联合身份规划预发布。

title.zh: 分支触发与 PR 验证

goal.en: Choose source-provider-specific validation and branch policies.
goal.zh: 按代码源选择验证触发与分支策略。

check.en: Why must PR validation behavior be checked against the actual repository provider?
check.zh: 为什么必须针对实际仓库提供方检查 PR 验证行为？

goal.en: Reuse pipeline logic without allowing uncontrolled command injection.
goal.zh: 复用流水线逻辑，并避免不受控命令注入。

check.en: When should a constrained parameter replace an arbitrary shell string?
check.zh: 什么时候应使用受约束参数替代任意 shell 字符串？

goal.en: Make failed tests and missing reports visible and release-blocking.
goal.zh: 明确展示测试失败与缺失报告，并阻止发布。

check.en: Why is uploading a test report not the same as enforcing a passing gate?
check.zh: 为什么上传测试报告不等于强制通过质量门禁？

goal.en: Promote a known artifact rather than rebuilding per environment.
goal.zh: 提升已知制品，而非每个环境重新构建。

check.en: Why should the production artifact match the artifact verified in staging?
check.zh: 生产制品为什么应与预发布验证的制品一致？

title.zh: 服务连接与工作负载联合身份

goal.en: Use scoped federated credentials instead of long-lived deployment secrets.
goal.zh: 使用有范围限制的联合凭证，避免长期部署密钥。

check.en: Which repository or pipeline should be allowed to use a deployment identity?
check.zh: 哪些仓库或流水线应被允许使用部署身份？

goal.en: Review declarative changes and expected resource impact.
goal.zh: 评审声明式变更与预期资源影响。

check.en: Why should a plan that replaces a stateful resource receive additional review?
check.zh: 替换有状态资源的计划为什么需要额外评审？

goal.en: Separate staging validation, settings, and production traffic.
goal.zh: 区分预发布验证、配置与生产流量。

check.en: Which settings must remain slot-specific during a swap?
check.zh: 交换槽位时，哪些配置必须仍属于各自槽位？

goal.en: Correlate release versions with errors, latency, and traces.
goal.zh: 关联发布版本与错误、延迟和链路。

check.en: Which telemetry would reveal a release that returns 200 but doubles latency?
check.zh: 哪个遥测指标能发现返回 200 却使延迟翻倍的发布？

project.en: Review a production release with protected approvals, compatible migrations, rollback evidence, and recovery objectives.
project.zh: 评审生产发布的受保护审批、兼容迁移、回滚证据与恢复目标。

goal.en: Keep production approvals outside untrusted pipeline edits.
goal.zh: 让生产审批独立于不可信流水线修改。

check.en: Why should an author not bypass approval by editing the pipeline YAML?
check.zh: 为什么不能让作者通过修改 YAML 绕过审批？

goal.en: Trace deployed binaries back to reviewed source and dependencies.
goal.zh: 将部署二进制追溯到已评审源码与依赖。

check.en: What evidence links a production artifact digest to the approved commit?
check.zh: 什么证据能关联生产制品摘要与批准的提交？

goal.en: Define health thresholds and a bounded rollback procedure.
goal.zh: 定义健康阈值与有时间限制的回滚流程。

check.en: What signal should stop a rollout before all users are affected?
check.zh: 什么信号应在所有用户受影响前停止发布？

title.zh: 数据库与应用发布顺序

goal.en: Use compatible expand-contract migrations across application versions.
goal.zh: 在新旧应用并存时使用兼容的扩展收缩迁移。

check.en: Why can reverting an app fail after a destructive schema migration?
check.zh: 破坏性结构迁移后，为什么回退应用可能失败？

goal.en: Constrain build access without breaking deployment connectivity.
goal.zh: 限制构建访问，同时维持部署连通性。

check.en: Why should untrusted PR code not execute on a privileged deployment agent?
check.zh: 不可信 PR 代码为什么不能运行在高权限部署代理上？

goal.en: Distinguish availability, backup, and tested recovery objectives.
goal.zh: 区分可用性、备份与经过验证的恢复目标。

check.en: How do RPO and RTO affect a regional recovery plan?
check.zh: RPO 与 RTO 如何影响区域恢复方案？

goal.en: Identify ownership and bound waste without assuming alerts stop spending.
goal.zh: 明确资源归属并控制浪费，不假定告警会停止支出。

check.en: Why does a budget alert not automatically cap cloud resource charges?
check.zh: 为什么预算告警不会自动封顶云资源费用？

goal.en: Document timeline, contributing causes, and verifiable prevention.
goal.zh: 记录时间线、促成原因与可验证预防措施。

check.en: What follow-up test would detect this incident mechanism before the next release?
check.zh: 什么后续测试能在下次发布前发现本次事故机制？

description.en: Build secure delivery workflows with CodePipeline, CodeBuild, AWS identities, and observable deployment strategies.
description.zh: 使用 CodePipeline、CodeBuild、AWS 身份与可观测部署策略构建安全交付流程。

prerequisite.en: Git, basic HTTP and containers, and YAML/JSON. Exercises review configurations; they do not deploy cloud resources.
prerequisite.zh: 具备 Git、HTTP、容器与 YAML/JSON 基础；练习评审配置，不会实际部署云资源。

project.en: Model source-to-artifact delivery and write a buildspec for a small tested application.
project.zh: 建模源码到制品的交付过程，并为带测试的小应用编写 buildspec。

goal.en: Separate validation, releasable artifacts, and production rollout.
goal.zh: 区分验证、可发布制品与生产上线。

check.en: Why does a green build not prove a production deployment is healthy?
check.zh: 构建通过为什么不能证明生产部署健康？

goal.en: Separate pipeline, build, and deployment permissions.
goal.zh: 区分流水线、构建与部署权限。

check.en: Why should a build role not receive unrestricted administrator access?
check.zh: 构建角色为什么不能获得无限制管理员权限？

goal.en: Identify where artifacts and deployment targets belong.
goal.zh: 明确制品与部署目标所在位置。

check.en: What can go wrong when a test pipeline targets a production account?
check.zh: 测试流水线指向生产账户会有什么问题？

goal.en: Connect a repository and preserve the exact source revision.
goal.zh: 连接代码仓库，并保留精确提交标识。

check.en: Why should release evidence identify a commit rather than only a branch name?
check.zh: 发布证据为什么应记录提交，而不仅是分支名？

goal.en: Model action dependencies and artifact flow.
goal.zh: 建模动作依赖与制品流转。

check.en: Which downstream action must stop when its required build artifact is missing?
check.zh: 所需构建制品缺失时，哪个下游动作必须停止？

goal.en: Place install, build, tests, and outputs in explicit phases.
goal.zh: 将安装、构建、测试与输出放入明确阶段。

check.en: Why must a failed test command propagate a nonzero build status?
check.zh: 为什么失败测试命令必须传递非零构建状态？

goal.en: Protect artifact access and distinguish storage from promotion.
goal.zh: 保护制品访问，并区分存储与提升。

check.en: Why is an artifact bucket not meant to be publicly writable?
check.zh: 为什么制品存储桶不能公开可写？

goal.en: Use scoped parameter or secret references and avoid log leakage.
goal.zh: 引用有范围限制的参数或密钥，并避免日志泄漏。

check.en: Why can printing the build environment disclose deployment credentials?
check.zh: 打印构建环境为什么可能泄漏部署凭证？

project.en: Design an immutable container artifact flow with tests, staging validation, and a manual production gate.
project.zh: 设计不可变容器制品流程，加入测试、预发布验证与生产人工门禁。

goal.en: Make quality requirements block artifact promotion.
goal.zh: 让质量要求能够阻止制品提升。

check.en: How can tests fail even when a shell pipeline exits successfully?
check.zh: 为什么测试失败时 shell 管道仍可能成功退出？

title.zh: 构建缓存与可复现输入

goal.en: Cache dependencies without treating cached output as authoritative.
goal.zh: 缓存依赖，不将缓存输出当作权威制品。

check.en: Why should a changed lockfile invalidate its dependency cache key?
check.zh: 锁文件改变后，为什么应使依赖缓存键失效？

goal.en: Deploy a verified digest rather than a mutable tag assumption.
goal.zh: 部署已验证摘要，不依赖可变标签假设。

check.en: Why can two deployments of latest run different image contents?
check.zh: 两次部署 latest 为什么可能运行不同内容？

goal.en: Coordinate task definitions, service health, and image versions.
goal.zh: 协调任务定义、服务健康与镜像版本。

check.en: Why does a running task not prove its application is ready for traffic?
check.zh: 任务运行中为什么不代表应用已准备好接收流量？

goal.en: Use the deployment-platform-specific lifecycle to validate readiness.
goal.zh: 按部署平台的生命周期验证就绪状态。

check.en: Why must lifecycle hooks be matched to the actual deployment target?
check.zh: 为什么必须让生命周期钩子匹配实际部署目标？

goal.en: Approve a specific revision using test and staging evidence.
goal.zh: 依据测试与预发布证据批准特定版本。

check.en: What should an approver verify beyond the pipeline showing green?
check.zh: 审批者除了查看流水线绿色外，还应验证什么？

goal.en: Review replacements and dependencies before infrastructure changes.
goal.zh: 基础设施变更前评审资源替换与依赖。

check.en: Why should replacing a database require more review than updating a tag?
check.zh: 替换数据库为什么比更新标签需要更多评审？

goal.en: Connect release identifiers to user-visible health signals.
goal.zh: 关联发布标识与用户可见健康信号。

check.en: Which alarm catches elevated application errors despite successful infrastructure deployment?
check.zh: 基础设施部署成功后，什么告警能发现应用错误增加？

project.en: Review a cross-account release with supply-chain evidence, progressive traffic, and a tested rollback plan.
project.zh: 评审跨账户发布的供应链证据、渐进流量与经验证的回滚方案。

goal.en: Scope role assumption and artifact decryption across accounts.
goal.zh: 限制跨账户角色扮演与制品解密权限。

check.en: Why does a trust policy alone not grant every required artifact permission?
check.zh: 为什么只有信任策略并不能授予所有制品权限？

title.zh: OIDC 联合身份与短期凭证

goal.en: Constrain external CI identity by issuer, audience, and subject.
goal.zh: 通过颁发者、受众与主体限制外部 CI 身份。

check.en: Why should a production role reject tokens from untrusted branches?
check.zh: 生产角色为什么应拒绝不可信分支的令牌？

title.zh: 蓝绿发布与金丝雀流量

goal.en: Select target-supported traffic shifting and health checks.
goal.zh: 选择目标平台支持的流量切换与健康检查。

check.en: What determines whether a traffic shift should continue or roll back?
check.zh: 什么决定流量切换继续还是回滚？

goal.en: Couple rollout health with a known-good artifact and recovery limits.
goal.zh: 关联发布健康、已知良好制品与恢复限制。

check.en: Why can rolling back an image fail after an incompatible database change?
check.zh: 不兼容数据库变更后，为什么回退镜像可能失败？

title.zh: 并发发布与过期版本提升

goal.en: Prevent older executions from overwriting newer releases.
goal.zh: 防止旧执行覆盖较新发布。

check.en: What happens if a slower older pipeline deploys after a newer one?
check.zh: 较慢的旧流水线在新流水线之后部署，会发生什么？

title.zh: 供应链证据与制品完整性

goal.en: Verify provenance and scanning policy before promotion.
goal.zh: 提升制品前验证来源与扫描策略。

check.en: What proves a scanned image is the same digest being deployed?
check.zh: 什么能证明已扫描镜像与待部署镜像摘要一致？

goal.en: Verify recovery objectives and clean up temporary build resources.
goal.zh: 验证恢复目标，并清理临时构建资源。

check.en: Which resources can keep incurring charges after a failed pipeline?
check.zh: 流水线失败后，哪些资源仍可能继续计费？

title.zh: 流水线威胁建模与事故复盘

goal.en: Review trust boundaries and add a regression for a release failure.
goal.zh: 评审信任边界，并为发布故障添加回归验证。

check.en: How could untrusted pull-request code exfiltrate a privileged build secret?
check.zh: 不可信 PR 代码可能如何窃取高权限构建密钥？

description.en: Build full-stack React applications with App Router, explicit server boundaries, and reliable production delivery.
description.zh: 使用 App Router、明确的服务端边界与可靠交付流程，构建全栈 React 应用。

prerequisite.en: React components, state, effects, TypeScript, and basic HTTP. Specify the Next.js version and cache configuration for version-sensitive exercises.
prerequisite.zh: 具备 React 组件、状态、副作用、TypeScript 与 HTTP 基础；涉及版本差异的练习需明确 Next.js 版本与缓存配置。

project.en: Build a typed content site with nested routes, shared layouts, and an interactive client island.
project.zh: 构建带类型的内容站点，包含嵌套路由、共享布局与客户端交互区域。

goal.en: Separate route files, components, and server-only modules.
goal.zh: 区分路由文件、组件与仅服务端模块。

check.en: Which files expose a route and which can remain colocated implementation details?
check.zh: 哪些文件会暴露路由，哪些可以只是同目录实现细节？

goal.en: Compose persistent layouts around route-specific content.
goal.zh: 围绕路由内容组合持久布局。

check.en: Why can a shared layout preserve state while a child page changes?
check.zh: 子页面变化时，共享布局为什么可能保留状态？

goal.en: Validate route parameters and use the version-appropriate async APIs.
goal.zh: 校验路由参数，并使用对应版本的异步 API。

check.en: Why must a product id from a route still be validated before querying?
check.zh: 为什么查询前仍需校验路由中的商品 id？

goal.en: Choose Link and programmatic navigation for explicit user flows.
goal.zh: 为明确的用户流程选择 Link 或编程式导航。

check.en: How does client navigation differ from forcing a full document reload?
check.zh: 客户端导航与强制重载整个文档有何区别？

title.zh: 服务端与客户端组件边界

goal.en: Keep data access on the server and interactive state in client components.
goal.zh: 在服务端保留数据访问，在客户端组件处理交互状态。

check.en: Why does adding use client expand the client module dependency boundary?
check.zh: 为什么添加 use client 会扩展客户端模块依赖边界？

title.zh: 可序列化属性与服务端密钥

goal.en: Pass safe data across component boundaries without exposing credentials.
goal.zh: 跨组件边界传递安全数据，避免泄漏凭证。

check.en: Why must a database connection or secret not be passed to a Client Component?
check.zh: 为什么不能将数据库连接或密钥传入客户端组件？

goal.en: Use scoped styling and reserve image space to avoid layout shifts.
goal.zh: 使用有作用域的样式，并预留图片空间避免布局偏移。

check.en: Why does a responsive image still need a deliberate sizing contract?
check.zh: 响应式图片为什么仍需要明确尺寸约束？

goal.en: Define route-aware titles and metadata on the appropriate server boundary.
goal.zh: 在合适的服务端边界定义路由标题与元数据。

check.en: How should two product pages get distinct titles without client-side title patches?
check.zh: 两个商品页如何无需客户端补丁即可获得不同标题？

project.en: Build an authenticated dashboard with server reads, validated mutations, loading states, and explicit cache behavior.
project.zh: 构建认证仪表盘，包含服务端读取、校验后的写入、加载状态与明确缓存行为。

title.zh: 服务端数据获取与瀑布请求

goal.en: Place reads near consumers and parallelize independent work.
goal.zh: 将读取放在使用方附近，并行处理独立任务。

check.en: Which of two independent reads can start before awaiting the other?
check.zh: 两个独立读取中，哪个可以在等待另一个之前启动？

goal.en: Use loading UI and Suspense around the work that can suspend.
goal.zh: 围绕可挂起任务使用加载界面与 Suspense。

check.en: How can a slow panel load without delaying the entire dashboard?
check.zh: 慢面板如何不阻塞整个仪表盘的显示？

goal.en: Distinguish missing resources from recoverable rendering failures.
goal.zh: 区分资源不存在与可恢复渲染失败。

check.en: Why should a missing product not be handled exactly like a database outage?
check.zh: 商品不存在为什么不应与数据库故障采用完全相同的处理？

title.zh: 路由处理器与 HTTP 约束

goal.en: Validate methods, bodies, status codes, and authorization.
goal.zh: 校验方法、请求体、状态码与授权。

check.en: Why must a POST handler validate the caller even when its page is protected?
check.zh: 页面已有保护，为什么 POST 处理器仍需校验调用者？

title.zh: 服务端函数与写入校验

goal.en: Validate untrusted inputs and authorize each mutation.
goal.zh: 校验不可信输入，并授权每次写入。

check.en: Does use server make a submitted record id trustworthy?
check.zh: use server 会让提交的记录 id 自动可信任吗？

title.zh: 表单、待处理状态与重复提交

goal.en: Coordinate validation errors and pending UI without assuming exactly-once delivery.
goal.zh: 协调校验错误与待处理界面，不假定只投递一次。

check.en: Why does disabling a submit button not guarantee an operation happens only once?
check.zh: 为什么禁用提交按钮不能保证操作只发生一次？

goal.en: Specify cache scope, freshness, and invalidation for the assumed version.
goal.zh: 按假设版本明确缓存范围、新鲜度与失效策略。

check.en: After editing a product, which cached views must be invalidated?
check.zh: 修改商品后，哪些缓存视图必须失效？

goal.en: Centralize session checks and authorize access to each owned record.
goal.zh: 集中处理会话检查，并针对每条归属记录授权。

check.en: Why is hiding an edit button insufficient to protect another user’s record?
check.zh: 为什么隐藏编辑按钮不足以保护他人的记录？

project.en: Review and deliver a production application with isolated personalized data, automated checks, telemetry, and a rollback plan.
project.zh: 评审并交付生产应用，具备个性化数据隔离、自动检查、遥测与回滚方案。

title.zh: 个性化数据与缓存隔离

goal.en: Prevent shared caches from mixing users or tenants.
goal.zh: 防止共享缓存混淆用户或租户数据。

check.en: What can leak if a user-specific result is cached without an identity boundary?
check.zh: 用户专属结果缓存时没有身份边界，可能泄漏什么？

title.zh: 水合一致性与浏览器 API

goal.en: Keep initial server and client output consistent.
goal.zh: 保持服务端与客户端初始输出一致。

check.en: Why can reading localStorage during initial rendering produce a hydration mismatch?
check.zh: 初始渲染读取 localStorage 为什么可能造成水合不匹配？

goal.en: Use request interception for routing while protecting the data boundary independently.
goal.zh: 通过请求拦截处理路由，并独立保护数据边界。

check.en: Why is a redirect in Proxy not a substitute for authorization in a mutation?
check.zh: 为什么 Proxy 重定向不能替代写入操作中的授权？

goal.en: Measure client dependencies before moving code across boundaries.
goal.zh: 跨边界移动代码前测量客户端依赖。

check.en: How can a client provider accidentally pull a large dependency into the browser bundle?
check.zh: 客户端 provider 如何意外将大型依赖打入浏览器包？

title.zh: 单元、集成与端到端证据

goal.en: Choose tests that verify server boundaries and real navigation behavior.
goal.zh: 选择能验证服务端边界与实际导航行为的测试。

check.en: What does an end-to-end unauthorized-write test prove that a hidden-button snapshot cannot?
check.zh: 未授权写入的端到端测试，能证明隐藏按钮快照无法证明的什么？

title.zh: 部署、运行时与环境密钥

goal.en: Match runtime capabilities and build-time versus runtime configuration.
goal.zh: 匹配运行时能力，并区分构建期与运行期配置。

check.en: Why can a public environment variable become fixed in the built client bundle?
check.zh: 公开环境变量为什么可能在构建后的客户端包中固定下来？

goal.en: Correlate slow requests and failures with a specific release.
goal.zh: 将慢请求与失败关联到特定发布。

check.en: What evidence separates a slow upstream query from a large client download?
check.zh: 什么证据能区分上游查询慢与客户端下载量过大？

goal.en: Review API changes, rehearse migrations, and define rollback evidence.
goal.zh: 评审 API 变化、演练迁移，并定义回滚证据。

check.en: Why must a cache-behavior change be tested before a framework upgrade reaches production?
check.zh: 框架升级上线前，为什么必须测试缓存行为变化？

description.en: Build validated, secure Python web applications with Django.
description.zh: 用 Django 构建经过校验、安全可靠的 Python Web 应用。

prerequisite.en: Python functions, classes, virtual environments, and basic HTTP and SQL.
prerequisite.zh: 具备 Python 函数、类、虚拟环境及 HTTP、SQL 基础。

project.en: Build a task tracker with models, templates, forms, and admin tools.
project.zh: 构建包含模型、模板、表单和管理后台的任务管理应用。

goal.en: Separate project configuration from reusable applications.
goal.zh: 区分项目配置与可复用应用。

check.en: What differs between startproject and startapp?
check.zh: startproject 和 startapp 有什么区别？

goal.en: Trace path parameters through a view to an HTTP response.
goal.zh: 追踪路径参数经过视图生成 HTTP 响应的过程。

check.en: How should a missing task return a 404?
check.zh: 任务不存在时，如何返回 404？

goal.en: Model fields, foreign keys, and deletion behavior.
goal.zh: 设计字段、外键与删除行为。

check.en: What does on_delete control for a foreign key?
check.zh: 外键的 on_delete 控制什么？

goal.en: Distinguish generating migration files from applying them.
goal.zh: 区分生成迁移文件与执行迁移。

check.en: Does makemigrations change the database schema immediately?
check.zh: makemigrations 会立即修改数据库结构吗？

goal.en: Filter and order records while identifying evaluation points.
goal.zh: 筛选、排序记录，并识别求值时机。

check.en: When does constructing a QuerySet issue SQL?
check.zh: 构建 QuerySet 时，什么时候会执行 SQL？

goal.en: Compose inherited templates and preserve automatic escaping.
goal.zh: 组合继承模板，并保留自动转义。

check.en: Why is marking user content safe dangerous?
check.zh: 为什么将用户内容标记为 safe 有危险？

goal.en: Validate bound forms before using cleaned_data.
goal.zh: 先校验绑定的表单，再使用 cleaned_data。

check.en: Can request.POST replace validated cleaned_data?
check.zh: request.POST 能替代已校验的 cleaned_data 吗？

goal.en: Configure admin access and explicitly choose editable fields.
goal.zh: 配置后台访问权限，并明确可编辑字段。

check.en: Why explicitly list fields in a public ModelForm?
check.zh: 公开的 ModelForm 为什么应显式列出字段？

project.en: Build a multi-user task application with permissions and regression tests.
project.zh: 构建带权限检查和回归测试的多用户任务应用。

goal.en: Use Django authentication and session lifecycle APIs.
goal.zh: 使用 Django 身份认证和会话生命周期 API。

check.en: Why should passwords use set_password rather than direct assignment?
check.zh: 密码为什么应通过 set_password 设置，而不是直接赋值？

goal.en: Scope each read and write to resources the caller may access.
goal.zh: 为每次读写限定调用者有权访问的资源。

check.en: Does login_required prove ownership of a task?
check.zh: login_required 能证明用户拥有某个任务吗？

goal.en: Protect state-changing requests and keep GET free of mutations.
goal.zh: 保护修改状态的请求，并避免 GET 执行修改。

check.en: Why is a CSRF token not an ownership check?
check.zh: 为什么 CSRF 令牌不能替代资源归属检查？

goal.en: Trace dispatch and customize querysets in class-based views.
goal.zh: 追踪 dispatch，并在类视图中定制查询集。

check.en: Where should a ListView restrict records to the current user?
check.zh: ListView 应在哪里将记录限制为当前用户的数据？

goal.en: Keep related writes atomic and defer side effects until commit.
goal.zh: 让相关写入保持原子性，并在提交后执行外部副作用。

check.en: Why send a confirmation using on_commit?
check.zh: 为什么通过 on_commit 发送确认通知？

title.zh: 关联数据与 N+1 查询

goal.en: Choose select_related or prefetch_related using relationship shape.
goal.zh: 根据关联类型选择 select_related 或 prefetch_related。

check.en: How can rendering task owners issue one query per row?
check.zh: 渲染任务所有者时，如何产生每行一次的查询？

goal.en: Validate uploads and separate untrusted media from executable content.
goal.zh: 校验上传内容，并将不可信媒体与可执行内容隔离。

check.en: Is a filename extension enough to trust an upload?
check.zh: 只检查扩展名就能信任上传内容吗？

goal.en: Test successful requests, invalid input, and forbidden resource access.
goal.zh: 测试正常请求、无效输入和越权访问。

check.en: Which test catches one user editing another user’s task?
check.zh: 哪个测试能发现用户修改他人任务的问题？

project.en: Prepare a production release with concurrency protection, diagnostics, and recovery checks.
project.zh: 准备生产交付，包含并发保护、诊断与恢复检查。

goal.en: Use database expressions or transactional locks for conflicting writes.
goal.zh: 用数据库表达式或事务锁处理冲突写入。

check.en: Why can read-modify-save lose a concurrent increment?
check.zh: 读取、修改再保存为什么可能丢失并发增量？

goal.en: Enforce invariants in the database as well as input validation.
goal.zh: 在数据库中约束不变量，同时保留输入校验。

check.en: Can two requests both pass a uniqueness precheck?
check.zh: 两个请求能同时通过唯一性预检查吗？

goal.en: Design cache keys and invalidation around identity and freshness.
goal.zh: 围绕用户身份和新鲜度设计缓存键与失效。

check.en: How could a shared cache key expose another user’s dashboard?
check.zh: 共用缓存键如何泄露其他用户的仪表盘？

goal.en: Distinguish async request handling from blocking dependencies.
goal.zh: 区分异步请求处理与阻塞依赖。

check.en: Does async def make a blocking library nonblocking?
check.zh: async def 能让阻塞库自动变为非阻塞吗？

goal.en: Order middleware and correlate errors without recording secrets.
goal.zh: 合理排列中间件，并在不记录秘密的前提下关联错误。

check.en: How does middleware order affect request and response processing?
check.zh: 中间件顺序如何影响请求与响应处理？

goal.en: Review DEBUG, hosts, HTTPS, secrets, and static file delivery.
goal.zh: 检查 DEBUG、主机限制、HTTPS、秘密与静态资源交付。

check.en: Why is runserver unsuitable as the production server?
check.zh: 为什么 runserver 不适合作为生产服务器？

goal.en: Use historical models and plan compatibility across releases.
goal.zh: 使用历史模型，并规划版本间兼容性。

check.en: Why use apps.get_model inside a data migration?
check.zh: 数据迁移中为什么使用 apps.get_model？

goal.en: Verify backups, migration outcomes, and rollback assumptions.
goal.zh: 验证备份、迁移结果与回滚假设。

check.en: Can reverting application code undo a destructive schema migration?
check.zh: 回退应用代码能撤销破坏性的数据库迁移吗？

description.en: Build typed applications with components, signals, routing, and dependency injection.
description.zh: 用组件、信号、路由和依赖注入构建类型明确的应用。

prerequisite.en: HTML, CSS, JavaScript modules, and TypeScript fundamentals.
prerequisite.zh: 具备 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 模块与 TypeScript 基础。

project.en: Build a standalone task board with typed components and reactive state.
project.zh: 用独立组件和响应式状态构建类型明确的任务看板。

goal.en: Declare component metadata and import template dependencies.
goal.zh: 声明组件元数据，并导入模板依赖。

check.en: Where does a standalone component declare a child dependency?
check.zh: 独立组件在哪里声明子组件依赖？

goal.en: Connect properties and events without direct DOM mutation.
goal.zh: 通过属性与事件连接界面，避免直接修改 DOM。

check.en: How do property binding and event binding differ?
check.zh: 属性绑定与事件绑定有什么区别？

goal.en: Render conditional and repeated content with stable identity.
goal.zh: 按条件和列表渲染内容，并保持稳定身份。

check.en: Why track a reorderable task list by task.id?
check.zh: 可重排的任务列表为什么应跟踪 task.id？

goal.en: Update writable signals and derive values with computed.
goal.zh: 更新可写信号，并用 computed 派生数值。

check.en: Does mutating an object inside a signal automatically notify consumers?
check.zh: 直接修改信号内部对象会自动通知使用者吗？

goal.en: Pass typed data down and emit user intent upward.
goal.zh: 向下传递类型明确的数据，向上发出用户意图。

check.en: Who should own state shared by two sibling components?
check.zh: 两个兄弟组件共享的状态应由谁持有？

goal.en: Provide services at the scope that owns their state.
goal.zh: 在拥有相应状态的作用域提供服务。

check.en: How can a component provider create a separate service instance?
check.zh: 组件级 provider 如何创建独立服务实例？

goal.en: Format displayed values without hiding business mutations.
goal.zh: 格式化展示值，避免隐藏业务修改。

check.en: Should a formatting pipe save a record to the server?
check.zh: 格式化管道应该向服务器保存记录吗？

goal.en: Access initialized views and release owned resources on destruction.
goal.zh: 访问初始化后的视图，并在销毁时释放自有资源。

check.en: What happens to an interval if its component never clears it?
check.zh: 组件从不清理定时器会发生什么？

project.en: Build a routed dashboard with validated forms, HTTP loading, and error handling.
project.zh: 构建带路由、表单校验、HTTP 加载和错误处理的仪表盘。

goal.en: Map nested views and respond to route parameter changes.
goal.zh: 映射嵌套视图，并响应路由参数变化。

check.en: Can a reused component receive a new route id without reconstruction?
check.zh: 复用的组件能在不重新创建时收到新的路由 id 吗？

goal.en: Model typed form controls and expose meaningful validation states.
goal.zh: 建模类型明确的表单控件，并展示有意义的校验状态。

check.en: Why must the server validate a form that passed client validation?
check.zh: 表单通过客户端校验后，为什么服务端仍需校验？

goal.en: Handle loading and errors while validating untrusted data.
goal.zh: 处理加载与错误，并校验不可信数据。

check.en: Does http.get<User> validate the JSON at runtime?
check.zh: http.get<User> 会在运行时校验 JSON 吗？

goal.en: Compose request streams and avoid nested subscriptions.
goal.zh: 组合请求流，避免嵌套订阅。

check.en: How can switchMap stop an older search result replacing a newer one?
check.zh: switchMap 如何防止旧搜索结果替换新结果？

title.zh: 信号与 RxJS 互操作

goal.en: Bridge observable values into signals with deliberate subscription ownership.
goal.zh: 将可观察值接入信号，并明确订阅归属。

check.en: Why avoid repeatedly calling toSignal for the same stream?
check.zh: 为什么避免对同一条流重复调用 toSignal？

goal.en: Apply cross-cutting request policies with bounded retries.
goal.zh: 应用通用请求策略，并限制重试次数。

check.en: Why can automatically retrying a POST duplicate work?
check.zh: 自动重试 POST 为什么可能重复执行操作？

title.zh: 路由守卫与服务端授权

goal.en: Use guards for navigation while enforcing access on the server.
goal.zh: 用守卫控制导航，同时在服务端落实访问检查。

check.en: Can a client-side route guard secure an API?
check.zh: 客户端路由守卫能保护 API 吗？

goal.en: Test visible interactions and deterministic HTTP success and failure.
goal.zh: 测试可见交互，以及确定性的 HTTP 成功和失败。

check.en: What test catches a loading indicator that remains after an error?
check.zh: 什么测试能发现请求报错后仍显示加载的问题？

project.en: Deliver an accessible, measured application with SSR checks and a tested upgrade plan.
project.zh: 交付可访问、经过性能测量的应用，包含 SSR 检查与升级验证方案。

goal.en: Separate local UI state from shared feature services.
goal.zh: 区分局部界面状态与共享功能服务。

check.en: When should a feature service be scoped below the application root?
check.zh: 功能服务什么时候应限制在应用根级以下的作用域？

goal.en: Use profiling to locate expensive updates before optimizing.
goal.zh: 先用性能分析定位高成本更新，再优化。

check.en: What evidence would justify changing a component detection strategy?
check.zh: 什么证据足以支持调整组件的检测策略？

title.zh: 懒加载路由与延迟视图

goal.en: Defer optional code while preserving loading and failure feedback.
goal.zh: 延后加载可选代码，同时保留加载与失败反馈。

check.en: What should users see while a deferred dependency loads?
check.zh: 延迟依赖加载时，用户应看到什么？

title.zh: 服务端渲染与浏览器边界

goal.en: Keep browser-only APIs outside server execution paths.
goal.zh: 让仅限浏览器的 API 避开服务端执行路径。

check.en: Why can reading window during rendering fail on the server?
check.zh: 渲染期间读取 window 为什么可能在服务端失败？

title.zh: 水合与 DOM 一致性

goal.en: Keep server and client DOM compatible during hydration.
goal.zh: 水合期间保持服务端与客户端 DOM 兼容。

check.en: How can direct DOM changes cause a hydration mismatch?
check.zh: 直接修改 DOM 如何造成水合不匹配？

goal.en: Preserve sanitization and review any bypass of security checks.
goal.zh: 保留净化机制，并审查任何绕过安全检查的操作。

check.zh: 对用户输入使用 bypassSecurityTrustHtml 为什么危险？

goal.en: Test keyboard navigation, names, and focus after navigation.
goal.zh: 测试键盘导航、可访问名称与页面导航后的焦点。

check.en: Where should focus move after opening and closing a dialog?
check.zh: 对话框打开和关闭后，焦点应移到哪里？

goal.en: Declare framework versions and verify migrations with production builds and tests.
goal.zh: 明确框架版本，并通过生产构建与测试验证迁移。

check.en: Why do successful update schematics still require behavioral tests?
check.zh: 升级脚本成功后，为什么仍需行为测试？

description.en: Package applications reproducibly and operate containers with clear resource and data boundaries.
description.zh: 可复现地打包应用，明确容器的资源与数据边界。

prerequisite.en: Basic shell commands, processes, HTTP, and application dependencies.
prerequisite.zh: 了解基本命令行、进程、HTTP 与应用依赖。

project.en: Describe and containerize a small HTTP service with persistent data.
project.zh: 为小型 HTTP 服务编写容器配置，并保留持久数据。

goal.en: Distinguish immutable image layers from container writable state.
goal.zh: 区分不可变镜像层与容器可写状态。

check.en: Does deleting a container delete its source image?
check.zh: 删除容器会删除来源镜像吗？

goal.en: Distinguish creating, starting, stopping, and removing a container.
goal.zh: 区分创建、启动、停止与删除容器。

check.en: Does docker run reuse a stopped container automatically?
check.zh: docker run 会自动复用已停止的容器吗？

goal.en: Separate build-time instructions from startup behavior.
goal.zh: 区分构建时指令与启动行为。

check.en: When do RUN and CMD execute?
check.zh: RUN 与 CMD 分别何时执行？

title.zh: 构建上下文与忽略规则

goal.en: Limit files sent to a build using .dockerignore.
goal.zh: 通过 .dockerignore 限制构建输入文件。

check.en: Can COPY read a file outside the build context?
check.zh: COPY 能读取构建上下文之外的文件吗？

goal.en: Map host ports and distinguish host from container loopback.
goal.zh: 映射主机端口，并区分主机与容器的回环地址。

check.en: Why can publishing a port fail when the app listens only on container localhost?
check.zh: 应用只监听容器 localhost 时，为什么发布端口仍可能无法访问？

goal.en: Choose storage by ownership and persistence requirements.
goal.zh: 根据归属与持久化需求选择存储。

check.en: What data survives container removal when stored in a named volume?
check.zh: 命名卷中的哪些数据会在删除容器后保留？

goal.en: Pass runtime configuration without baking secrets into images.
goal.zh: 传入运行时配置，避免将秘密写入镜像。

check.en: Does an environment variable make a secret inaccessible to container inspection?
check.zh: 使用环境变量能让秘密无法被容器检查读取吗？

goal.en: Use logs, inspection, and exit status to explain failures.
goal.zh: 通过日志、检查信息与退出状态解释失败。

check.en: Which evidence distinguishes a crashed process from a port mapping problem?
check.zh: 哪些证据能区分进程崩溃与端口映射问题？

project.en: Design a Compose application with an API, database, health checks, and reproducible builds.
project.zh: 设计包含 API、数据库、健康检查与可复现构建的 Compose 应用。

goal.en: Define services, networks, and volumes declaratively.
goal.zh: 以声明方式定义服务、网络与卷。

check.en: How do services and containers differ when scaling a service?
check.zh: 扩容服务时，服务与容器有什么区别？

goal.en: Connect services using network-scoped names and container ports.
goal.zh: 使用网络作用域中的名称和容器端口连接服务。

check.zh: API 内的 localhost 为什么不是数据库服务？

goal.en: Separate process startup, health status, and application retries.
goal.zh: 区分进程启动、健康状态与应用重试。

check.en: Does starting the database container prove it accepts connections?
check.zh: 数据库容器启动就证明能接受连接了吗？

goal.zh: 从构建阶段只复制运行时所需产物。

check.en: Why can a runtime image omit the compiler?
check.zh: 运行时镜像为什么可以不包含编译器？

goal.zh: 合理排列构建输入，以复用高成本依赖层。

check.zh: 为什么先复制依赖清单，再复制经常变化的源文件？

goal.zh: 让运行用户权限匹配挂载存储。

check.en: Why can switching USER make a mounted directory unwritable?
check.zh: 切换 USER 为什么可能使挂载目录无法写入？

goal.zh: 使用 exec 形式启动，并将终止信号传递给应用。

check.zh: Shell 包装脚本如何阻碍优雅停机？

goal.zh: 区分可变标签与基于内容的镜像身份。

check.en: Can the same image tag resolve to different bytes tomorrow?
check.zh: 同一镜像标签明天能指向不同内容吗？

project.zh: 评审容器交付的可复现性、隔离、资源限制与数据恢复。

goal.zh: 限制资源，并诊断内存相关终止。

check.en: Why can a container be killed without an application exception?
check.zh: 容器为什么可能在没有应用异常时被终止？

goal.zh: 通过秘密挂载传入凭据，避免持久化到镜像层。

check.en: Does deleting a copied secret in a later layer remove it from earlier layers?
check.zh: 后续层删除复制过的秘密，会清除早期层中的秘密吗？

goal.en: Review artifact provenance alongside dependency and vulnerability evidence.
goal.zh: 结合依赖和漏洞证据检查产物来源。

check.en: Does a pinned digest alone prove an image is trustworthy?
check.zh: 固定摘要本身能证明镜像可信吗？

goal.en: Match target architecture to dependencies and runtime images.
goal.zh: 让目标架构匹配依赖和运行时镜像。

check.en: Why can an amd64 binary fail inside an arm64 image?
check.zh: amd64 二进制文件为什么可能在 arm64 镜像中失败？

title.zh: 权限能力与守护进程访问

goal.en: Reduce capabilities and recognize privileged daemon interfaces.
goal.zh: 收缩能力权限，并识别高权限守护进程接口。

check.en: Why is mounting the Docker socket a major privilege grant?
check.zh: 挂载 Docker socket 为什么会授予高权限？

goal.zh: 规划一致性备份，并验证恢复后的应用数据。

check.en: Why may copying live database files produce an unusable backup?
check.zh: 复制运行中的数据库文件为什么可能生成不可用备份？

goal.en: Inspect unused resources before choosing a scoped cleanup.
goal.zh: 先检查未用资源，再选择限定范围的清理。

check.en: What data could a volume-pruning command remove?
check.zh: 卷清理命令可能删除什么数据？

goal.zh: 构建一次，推广已验证产物，并明确回滚引用。

check.zh: 为各环境重新构建为什么削弱产物一致性？
